data.title: 因幡巡 · 暂停一下，先尝一口
data.description: 客厅的游戏画面停在暂停菜单。巡抱着靠垫坐在地毯上，把装着新烤饼干的小碟往你这边推了推，手柄还放在膝边。
data.promptProse: Meguru sits on the living-room rug in a coral sweatshirt and navy checked lounge pants. Her controller lies beside her knee while she slides a small plate of cookies across the low table toward the viewer. A shaded table lamp lights her face and the cushion in her lap.
data.animaCaption: She moves the cookie plate with one hand; the controller stays on the rug.
data.action: 把饼干碟推向你，手柄暂放膝边
